limitations: This is a 2x2x2x2 diagnostic screen with ten seeds per cell, not a full parameter-identification campaign.
Duration changes the existing second-half metric window; warm-up and sustained inflow were not independently controlled.
The threshold grid is an explicit sensitivity analysis, not external calibration against a reference implementation or visually adjudicated lane-forming case.
All execution was native local Linux/x86_64; the historical #5149 comparator was generated on macOS/arm64, so cross-platform numeric identity is not claimed.
Raw rows, checkpoints, and logs remain ignored worktree-local artifacts with no durable retrieval pointer; this tracked summary is the compact evidence surface.

default_cell.definition: length=24 m, corridor_width=5 m, pedestrians=24, steps=400

verdict.condition_that_would_change_conclusion: A threshold-calibrated reference configuration, independent warm-up/inflow controls, or a parameter sweep that produces stable clear segregation would change the interpretation.
verdict.mechanism_conclusion: Across the tested geometry, population, duration, and calibration levels, no cell reached the clear lane threshold reproducibly; weak-threshold rates varied with seed and cell, so the result narrows but does not distinguish scenario, threshold, and model explanations.
